field.field_definition: run02 frozen elliptical smoothstep; unchanged continuous height and linear-light color blend

refinement.method: local conforming red-green triangle edge bisection with shared-edge midpoint IDs
refinement.refined_region: all triangles intersecting the motif support plus a 1.5x elliptical transition band
refinement.t_junctions: FORBIDDEN; all incident faces split on each shared marked edge
refinement.theta_seam: periodic shortest-angle chart; midpoint IDs deduplicated by shared topological edge
refinement.baseline_ids_and_coordinates: all run02 vertex IDs and both XYZ arrays retained as an unchanged prefix
refinement.new_vertex_lineage: source baseline triangle ID plus per-face barycentric corner coordinates and canonical per-vertex owner

acceptance.seam_uniqueness: no duplicate outer rest coordinates rounded to 1e-12 mm; seam samples present
acceptance.finite_geometry_probes: each outer relief triangle barycenter and all three edge midpoints compared to continuous X1
acceptance.geometry_gate_scope: finite fixture probes only; not a certified maximum, Hausdorff bound, or global error guarantee
acceptance.normal_angle: record RMS, p95, max at barycenters and edge midpoints; no acceptance threshold set
acceptance.edge_metrics: actual maximum chart and displaced 3D edge lengths overall and within support plus transition; report ratios to 0.45 mm amplitude
acceptance.topology: closed two-manifold, consistent winding, one component, Euler characteristic 2, positive volume, no duplicate/repeated/zero-area faces
acceptance.density_fail_behavior: mark FAIL and stop before attempting the next finer candidate
acceptance.candidate_language: one analytic sample at two mesh resolutions; no independent samples, fracture labels, ground truth, or training data
